title: Fabrication of high-strength and self-healing polyurethane composites via Diels–Alder dynamic bonds for sustainable thermal management materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16586-16594
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00787B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhangyong Yu, Zhaokun Yang
Dynamically reversible polyurethane (DRPU) elastomers with good mechanical, adhesive and self-healing properties were synthesized. With the addition of f3-Al2O3 filler, DRPU0.52/80% f3-Al2O3 exhibited the high thermal conductivity.
